statement: NVIDIA's AI accelerator share is projected to fall from a 2024 peak of 87% to 81% in 2025E and 75% in 2026E.
why: A steady share decline from the peak means the incumbent is capturing a shrinking slice of a growing market, which changes who benefits from the next wave of accelerator spend.

impact.mechanism: Share erosion toward custom silicon and second-source merchant GPUs reduces the incumbent's capture rate of total accelerator spending even as the market expands.

confidence.basis: Secondary analyst estimate, and the document itself notes estimates range 70%-86% depending on methodology.

dispersion: The same document notes analyst estimates for 2026 range 70%-86% depending on whether hyperscaler custom silicon is included.
